architecture.note: PortraitOptions resolves generic authored/default settings with caller-supplied subject color. Shared ModelPreview/ModelAssetProvider owns load, pose and lifetime; GamePortrait supplies selected-subject data. No portrait-specific alternate asset loader/animator.

native_api.note: Shared ModelPreview and PortraitOptions form native preview API; public-header consumer and actual native client cover source switching/background/fallback.

performance.note: Scoped native Debug/Rosetta workload:256-handle selection every update, separate selected animated portrait, and four projectile scenes. Post-warmup CPU120-frame means<=16.04ms, sampled GPU frames<16.67ms,RSS<512MiB. First selection warmup block17.96ms is retained. Allocation review records bounded vectors/pools and fixed-size presentation; no p95/zero-allocation/mobile claim.

platforms.note: Verified scope: native macOS Metal and Emscripten browser WebGL runtime, using retained real captures. Windows, Linux desktop and physical mobile devices are NOT RUN; these results do not establish their backend/runtime parity. Detailed background/animation/fallback cases are native Metal; browser evidence is the authored demo smoke.

dependencies.note: Existing native model/animation/provider infrastructure reused, no second model loader or new package.

headless.note: Presentation-only selected-subject preview; no server-side portrait or simulation state.

examples.note: Controls demo includes authored static and animated glTF portraits; actual Metal and Web controls captures show selected subjects.
